brief:
Hamas urged the International Criminal Court, UN bodies, and human rights organizations to document testimonies and information revealed in the documentary film "Naza" (NAZA), according to Shehab Wire. The Palestinian resistance movement called for using the material in proceedings against those responsible for crimes in Gaza.

The film appears to contain witness accounts related to alleged violations during the conflict. Hamas's statement reflects efforts to channel documentary evidence into formal accountability mechanisms at international and UN-affiliated institutions.

title: Hamas calls for documenting Gaza war crimes evidence from 'Naza' film
